title: Publish your agent's analysis as a shareable web page
summary: A developer built a skill letting Claude Code or Codex turn analysis into interactive web pages, creating a GitHub repo and hosting automatically, shown in a demo video.
agent_role: The agent builds the page with diagrams and widgets, creates or reuses a GitHub repo and turns on hosting; the human asks for it and reviews.
outcome: Author shows a demo of pages published with stable links and comments.
what_they_did: A developer made an add-on skill for Claude Code and Codex. It turns an analysis into an interactive page with diagrams and widgets. The agent then creates or reuses a GitHub project and switches on free web hosting.
how_it_went: The author shares a demo video and says pages get stable links, saved version history and room for comments.
prompt: Take the analysis we just did on [topic] and turn it into a single interactive web page with clear diagrams and simple widgets. Then publish it on GitHub Pages using my repo [repo name], or propose creating a new one. Show me the page draft and the exact repo and hosting changes you plan to make, and wait for my approval before pushing anything.

curation.rationale: A thin but genuine workflow where the agent turns analysis into a web page and sets up the hosting itself, with a demo video; few details beyond that.
